description: Pinned reference corpus for the cold query-latency budget (issue #255): a snapshot of Egregore's own src/query/ subsystem (51 Rust files) plus a minimal Cargo.toml, scanned with a pinned transaction time and repository identity. Representative of a small crate's code graph; the benchmark records the actual record count in every report so corpus size stays auditable even as the extractor evolves.
reference_machine_class: GitHub Actions ubuntu-latest runner (the CI gate). Local runs on a 2-CPU sandbox VM measured p50 ~0.5s (graph) unloaded; expect wide margin on the reference class.
